warning_explanations.pre_black_box_flags: Raw tables remain unchanged. Of 1970 flagged cells, 1960 have the actual is_synlib_operator=true and is_unmapped=true attributes. report_reference/report_cell label them synthetic operators. The remaining ten are internal logic_0/logic_1 constant cells, with combinational attributes and source constant connections. They are not 1970 unresolved user IP blocks. After compile -no_map all cell references are explained and none has the black-box flag.
warning_explanations.post_raw_missing_design_or_library: The raw get_designs/get_lib_cells absence counts include native no-map GEN/SEQGEN cells. Actual cell attributes and classifications explain them. They must not be reported as unresolved IP counts.
warning_explanations.VER-329_VER-533: Existing package declaration style: local-parameter keyword use and default enum width. These do not diagnose a new decode-patch port or storage error.
warning_explanations.VER-318_ELAB-332: Signed/unsigned conversions occur in the fixed packages, constant configuration derivation and existing dispatcher arithmetic. ELAB-332 occurs at the two existing aggregate defaults at source lines 422 and 436; DC assumes 32-bit unsized constants. Neither decode edit adds arithmetic, a signal width, or a new such warning. These are retained typing warnings, not a zero-warning claim or proof that all arithmetic widths are correct.
warning_explanations.VER-1005: The test support constant function assigns members of its input cfg value and returns the modified value. This is a by-value configuration function, not a top-level hardware input driven internally.
warning_explanations.VER-61_ELAB-311: Constant feature choices remove unsupported FP-support alternatives, disabled-feature checks and exhausted CASE defaults. The wrapper fixes FPUSupportHalfSingleDouble, enabled fixed-point, segment and FP extensions. These diagnostics are the same source categories in both runs.
warning_explanations.VER-104: DC ignores an unsupported unlabeled $error construct in ara_pkg.sv. No claim is made that DC executed or verified that assertion. This is separate from the structural hardware result.
warning_explanations.LINT-1_LINT-2_LINT-8_LINT-28: Pre dead cells and post unused arithmetic bits/carry ports are present. The only pre unconnected dispatcher input fields are acc_cons_en and inval_ready. Post adds unused DesignWare arithmetic/carry ports; no entire DUT was removed. All 738 sequential cells are retained.
warning_explanations.LINT-29: Feedthrough includes the explicit trans_id response assignment and pass-through segment request fields. It is not a multiple-driver diagnostic.
warning_explanations.LINT-31_LINT-52: The 65 zero invalidation outputs share constant zero. Lane vxrm outputs intentionally share the same CSR rounding state. The wrapper exposes the same fields, so some post warnings appear at both hierarchy levels. These shorted-output messages do not imply conflicting drivers.
warning_explanations.LINT-32_LINT-33: Counter constant controls and shared arithmetic operands connect the same nets to more than one input pin. This is not multiple drivers on a net. No separate multiple-driver diagnostic is reported.
warning_explanations.VO-12_VO-4_VO-11: VO-12 and RPT-7 reflect deliberate generic no-map output. VO-4 is the Verilog writer assign/tran notice; it is not evidence of an inferred tri-state cell. VO-11 creates SYNOPSYS_UNCONNECTED names for unconsumed hierarchical outputs, including the exposed constant fields. The tables contain no tri-state cell reference.
warning_explanations.TIM-134_TIM-216: High-fanout estimation and missing external input delays are expected with a reporting clock only. The loop sections have no loop warning. These reports do not establish timing closure.

limitations: This is structural review of two real-module DC runs, not a functional proof, equivalence check, mapped synthesis, timing closure or physical signoff.

The local snapshot does not contain pre/post_generic.v or the DDC. This review did not reopen a DDC or rescan the written netlist. The conclusions use the preserved design, timing, sequential, reference and cell-attribute reports.
The package $error was not supported by DC. Its assertion semantics were not verified by this synthesis run.
Source bindings match the command source SHA and the two-condition patch. Full dependency provenance remains the responsibility of the existing execution records.
